name: the qualifier test is INVERTED, so a qualified reference fires and a bare one passes — the whole predicate backwards, which is the defect this guard exists to avoid
expect: ⭐ a BARE #N added to a spine doc is DETECTED

name: the ORDINAL allowance goes, so `Phase 6 #1` fires — the shape that was ~90% of the 2026-08-27 sample and the gap the self-test caught on its first run
expect: an ORDINAL in a title passes — the ~90% of the 2026-08-27 sample

name: the lookbehind goes, so a URL fragment and a `##4` heading are read as references — three false-positive shapes at once

name: ⛔ scope goes UNCHECKED, so scripts/ comes back in — 87% of firings lived there and that is the axis the measurement chose
expect: ⭐ a bare #N in scripts/ is OUT of scope — 87% of firings lived there

name: a git failure returns an EMPTY diff instead of raising, so an unresolvable base is a silent PASS — the fail-open this repo's rc contract exists to refuse
expect: ⛔ an unresolvable base is CANNOT RUN, never a pass
